description.raw: '''Passive - Beauty in Death:''' Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
description.text: Passive - Beauty in Death: Whenever Jhin kills an enemy champion, he summons a Blooming Lotus Trap on their corpse.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]] after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]] for 4 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Jhin places a Lotus Trap at the target location which, upon landing, becomes stealthed after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting sight within its radius. The Lotus Trap blooms upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming revealed for 4 seconds.

description3.raw: '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
description3.text: Jhin periodically stocks a Lotus Trap charge, up to a maximum of 2.

description4.raw: ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing magic damage to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] as well as against [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
description4.text: Blooming Lotus Traps slow enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing magic damage to enemies. Lotus Traps deal 65% damage against minions as well as against champions and monsters who have been struck by another Lotus Trap in the last 1 second.

description5.raw: ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''
description5.text: See Pets for more details about Lotus Traps.

leveling4.raw:

20 / 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 (+ 120% AD) (+ 100% AP)
'''Reduced Damage:'''

notes.raw: * ''Beauty in Death'' does not consume ''Lotus Trap'' charges. * The ''Lotus Trap'' will stop upon encountering a [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] or [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]]. * ''Beauty in Death'' does not trigger after killing a [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clone]]. * The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''. ** This debuff is shared between ''Captive Audience'' and [[File:Jhin Curtain Call.png|20xpx|border|link=Jhin#Curtain Call|An icon for Jhin's ability Curtain Call]] [[Jhin#Curtain Call|Curtain Call]].
notes.text:
Beauty in Death does not consume Lotus Trap charges.
The Lotus Trap will stop upon encountering a Wind Wall or Unbreakable.
Beauty in Death does not trigger after killing a clone.
The reveal debuff is named Caught Out.
* This debuff is shared between Captive Audience and Curtain Call.
